- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:lines 3098 and 3207 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: This PR establishes (from run 32891957030's `! [rejected] main -> origin/main (non-fast-forward)` hard failure) that explicit remote-tracking refspecs must carry the `+` force prefix, and adds it at every such refspec in scripts/ and workflows. The two ai-memory fetch sites were left unforced; the second one (the push-retry loop at ~3207) treats a failed fetch as fatal (`raise MemoryGitError(...)`), so a divergent local `refs/remotes/origin/ai-memory` ref aborts the retry loop instead of refetching.
  WHY: Impact is bounded (memory writes fail open and never fail the workflow), so this is a consistency gap, not a blocker.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k3 ===
